## Objective
Map ai output to included small intestinal mucosa

### Issues / Deviations
This is slow. Revisit original code at bottom before function to see if that was faster - try smma_04_01 as test (took hours for function)

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)

#When merging geometries sometimes linestrings are created - these slow down further mapping
filter_out_line_geometries <- function(sf_df, geom_col = "geometry") {
  sf_df %>%
    filter(
      !st_geometry_type(.data[[geom_col]]) %in% c("LINESTRING", "MULTILINESTRING", "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION")
    )
}

#To filter a centroid to a region 
filter_objects_in_region <- function(object_centroids, region_geom) {
  intersection_indices <- st_intersects(object_centroids, region_geom, sparse = TRUE)

  object_indices <- sapply(intersection_indices, function(x) if (length(x) > 0) x[1] else NA)

  stopifnot(length(object_indices) == nrow(object_centroids))

  object_centroids %>%
    mutate(tissue_index = object_indices) %>%
    filter(!is.na(tissue_index))
}

#to process ai output by included mucosa region
map_ai_output <- function(muc, included_mucosa_list, artefact_dir, combos_dir, output_dir) {
  
  message("Processing mucosa ", muc)

  mucosa_list <- included_mucosa_list %>% filter(name == muc)
  image_fragment <- paste(mucosa_list$image_name, mucosa_list$fragment_name, sep = "_")

  # Read mucosa artefacts
  mucosa_path <- file.path(artefact_dir, paste0(muc, "_si_artefact.geojson"))
  mucosa <- st_read(mucosa_path, quiet = TRUE) %>% st_set_crs(0) %>%
    rename(artefact_class = classification)
  mucosa_geom <- mucosa %>% select(name, geometry)

  # Read layers
  layers_path <- file.path(combos_dir, paste0(image_fragment, "_layers.geojson"))
  layers <- st_read(layers_path, quiet = TRUE) %>% st_set_crs(0) %>%
    rename(layers_name = name) %>%
    mutate(mucosa_name = mucosa$mucosa_name)

  layers_intersection <- st_intersection(layers, mucosa_geom)

  # Union layers by classification
  union_layer <- function(class_label) {
    layers_intersection %>%
      filter(classification == class_label) %>%
      group_by(image_name, fragment_name, mucosa_name, classification, objectType, isLocked) %>%
      summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(name = paste(muc, classification, sep = "_")) 
  }

  villi_geom  <- union_layer("villi") %>%
      select(name, geometry)
  crypts_geom <- union_layer("crypts") %>%
      select(name, geometry)

  # Read tissues and intersect
  tissues_path <- file.path(combos_dir, paste0(image_fragment, "_tissues.geojson"))
  tissues <- st_read(tissues_path, quiet = TRUE) %>% st_set_crs(0) %>%
    rename(tissues_name = name) %>%
    mutate(mucosa_name = mucosa$mucosa_name)

  tissues_villi <- st_intersection(tissues, villi_geom) %>%
    filter_out_line_geometries() %>%
    mutate(name = paste(name, classification, sep = "_"))

  tissues_crypts <- st_intersection(tissues, crypts_geom) %>%
    filter_out_line_geometries() %>%
    mutate(name = paste(name, classification, sep = "_"))

  # Helper to unify tissues by classification
  union_tissue <- function(tissues, label, compartment) {
    tissues %>%
      filter(classification == compartment) %>%
      group_by(image_name, fragment_name, mucosa_name, name, classification, objectType, isLocked) %>%
      summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(classification = paste(label, compartment, sep = "_"))
  }

  villi_epithelium_geom       <- union_tissue(tissues_villi, "villi", "epithelium") %>% select(name, geometry)
  villi_lamina_propria_geom   <- union_tissue(tissues_villi, "villi", "lamina_propria") %>% select(name, geometry)
  villi_lumen_united          <- union_tissue(tissues_villi, "villi", "lumen")
  crypts_epithelium_geom      <- union_tissue(tissues_crypts, "crypts", "epithelium") %>% select(name, geometry)
  crypts_lamina_propria_geom  <- union_tissue(tissues_crypts, "crypts", "lamina_propria") %>% select(name, geometry)
  crypts_lumen_united         <- union_tissue(tissues_crypts, "crypts", "lumen")

  # Read and clean lymphocytes
  lymphocytes_path <- file.path(combos_dir, paste0(image_fragment, "_lymphocytes.geojson"))
  lymphocytes <- st_read(lymphocytes_path, quiet = TRUE) %>%
    st_set_crs(0) %>%
    mutate(area = st_area(geometry)) %>%
    group_by(name) %>%
    arrange(desc(area)) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(-area) %>%
    select(image_name, fragment_name, name:isLocked, geometry)

  lymphocyte_outlines_geom <- lymphocytes %>% select(name, geometry)
  lymphocyte_centroids <- st_centroid(lymphocytes)

  # Helper to get outlines per region
  map_and_label_lymphocytes <- function(region_geom, label) {
    filter_objects_in_region(lymphocyte_centroids, region_geom) %>%
      mutate(classification = paste(label, classification, sep = "_")) %>%
      select(-tissue_index) %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      left_join(lymphocyte_outlines_geom)
  }

  villi_epithelium_outlines      <- map_and_label_lymphocytes(villi_epithelium_geom, "villi_epithelium")
  villi_lamina_propria_outlines  <- map_and_label_lymphocytes(villi_lamina_propria_geom, "villi_lamina_propria")
  crypts_epithelium_outlines     <- map_and_label_lymphocytes(crypts_epithelium_geom, "crypts_epithelium")
  crypts_lamina_propria_outlines <- map_and_label_lymphocytes(crypts_lamina_propria_geom, "crypts_lamina_propria")

  # Create centroid summary
  mucosa_lymphocyte_centroids <- bind_rows(
    villi_epithelium_outlines,
    villi_lamina_propria_outlines,
    crypts_epithelium_outlines,
    crypts_lamina_propria_outlines
  ) %>%
    mutate(mucosa_name = mucosa$mucosa_name) %>%
    select(image_name, fragment_name, mucosa_name, name:geometry)

  # Unite outlines for export
  lymphocyte_outlines_united <- bind_rows(
    villi_epithelium_outlines,
    villi_lamina_propria_outlines,
    crypts_epithelium_outlines,
    crypts_lamina_propria_outlines
  ) %>%
    group_by(image_name, fragment_name, classification, objectType, isLocked) %>%
    summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(mucosa_name = mucosa$mucosa_name, name = classification)

  # Create final composite sf
  mucosa_select <- mucosa %>%
    mutate(name = paste("mucosa", orientation_class, artefact_class, "artefact", sep = "_"),
           classification = "mucosa",
           objectType = "annotation",
           isLocked = TRUE) %>%
    select(image_name, fragment_name, mucosa_name, name, classification, objectType, isLocked, geometry)

  output_layers <- bind_rows(
    mucosa_select,
    union_layer("villi"),
    union_layer("crypts"),
    union_tissue(tissues_villi, "villi", "epithelium"),
    union_tissue(tissues_villi, "villi", "lamina_propria"),
    villi_lumen_united,
    union_tissue(tissues_crypts, "crypts", "epithelium"),
    union_tissue(tissues_crypts, "crypts", "lamina_propria"),
    crypts_lumen_united,
    lymphocyte_outlines_united
  )

  # Write outputs
  st_write(output_layers, file.path(output_dir, paste0(muc, "_mapped_ai_output.geojson")), quiet = TRUE, delete_dsn = TRUE)
  st_write(mucosa_lymphocyte_centroids, file.path(output_dir, paste0(muc, "_lymphocyte_centroids.geojson")), quiet = TRUE, delete_dsn = TRUE)
}


map_all_ai_outputs <- function(mucosa_names,
                               included_mucosa_list,
                               artefact_dir,
                               combos_dir,
                               output_dir) {
  
  for (muc in mucosa_names) {
    try({
      map_ai_output(
        muc = muc,
        included_mucosa_list = included_mucosa_list,
        artefact_dir = artefact_dir,
        combos_dir = combos_dir,
        output_dir = output_dir
      )
    }, silent = FALSE)
  }
}

```

### Process combos for labl_2020_tuning

#### Input
- *subset_labl_2020_tuning.json* (fe_si_images/output/process/subset)
metadata for images in subset
- *<image_name>_<fragment_name>_<mucosa_name>_artefacts.geojson* (fe_si_models/artefact/output/artefact)
mucosa regions classified by orientation and artefact
- *

####

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

subset <- fromJSON("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_images/output/process_subset/subset_labl_2020_tuning.json")

artefact_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_models/artefact/output/artefact/"
combos_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_models/combos/output/combos/"

included_mucosa_list <- fromJSON("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_models/artefact/output/artefact/template_artefacts.json") %>%
  rename(artefact_class = classification) %>%
  filter(artefact_class == "adequate" | artefact_class == "marginal") %>%
  distinct(name, .keep_all = TRUE)

image_names <- included_mucosa_list$image_name %>%
  unique()

filtered_subset <- subset %>% filter(image_name %in% image_names) 

image_paths <- filtered_subset$file_path

writeLines(image_paths, "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_models/combos/output/mapped_ai_output/file_paths_labl_2020_tuning.txt")

mucosa_names <- included_mucosa_list$name

output_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_models/combos/output/mapped_ai_output/"

map_all_ai_outputs(mucosa_names = mucosa_names,
                   included_mucosa_list = included_mucosa_list,
                   artefact_dir = artefact_dir,
                   combos_dir = combos_dir,
                   output_dir = output_dir)

```



```{r}

for (muc in mucosa_names[1]){
  
  message("Processing mucosa ", muc)
  
  mucosa_list <- included_mucosa_list %>% filter(name == muc)
  
  image_fragment <- paste(mucosa_list$image_name, mucosa_list$fragment_name, sep = "_")
  
  mucosa_path <- paste0(artefact_dir, muc, "_", "si_artefact.geojson")
  
  mucosa <- st_read(mucosa_path, quiet = TRUE) %>% st_set_crs(0) %>%
    rename(artefact_class = classification)
  
  mucosa_geom <- mucosa %>% select(name, geometry)
  
  layers_path <- paste0(combos_dir, image_fragment, "_layers.geojson")
  
  layers <- st_read(layers_path, quiet = TRUE) %>% st_set_crs(0) %>%
    rename(layers_name = name) %>%
    mutate(mucosa_name = mucosa$mucosa_name)
  
  layers_intersection <- st_intersection(layers, mucosa_geom)
  
  villi_united <- layers_intersection %>% 
    filter(classification == "villi") %>%
    group_by(image_name, fragment_name, mucosa_name, classification, objectType, isLocked) %>%
    summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop") %>% 
    mutate(name = paste(muc, classification, sep = "_"))
  
  villi_geom <- villi_united  %>%
    select(name, geometry)
  
  crypts_united <- layers_intersection %>% 
    filter(classification == "crypts") %>%
    group_by(image_name, fragment_name, mucosa_name, classification, objectType, isLocked) %>%
    summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop") %>% 
    mutate(name = paste(muc, classification, sep = "_")) 
  
  crypts_geom <- crypts_united %>%
    select(name, geometry)
  
  tissues_path <- paste0(combos_dir, image_fragment, "_tissues.geojson")
  
  tissues <- st_read(tissues_path, quiet = TRUE) %>% st_set_crs(0) %>%
    rename(tissues_name = name) %>%
    mutate(mucosa_name = mucosa$mucosa_name)
  
  tissues_villi <- st_intersection(tissues, villi_geom) %>%
    filter_out_line_geometries() %>%
    mutate(name = paste(name, classification, sep = "_"))
  
  tissues_crypts <- st_intersection(tissues, crypts_geom) %>%
    filter_out_line_geometries() %>%
    mutate(name = paste(name, classification, sep = "_"))
  
  villi_epithelium_united <- tissues_villi %>%
    filter(classification == "epithelium") %>%
    group_by(image_name, fragment_name, mucosa_name, name, classification, objectType, isLocked) %>%
    summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(classification = paste("villi", classification, sep = "_"))
  
  villi_epithelium_geom <- villi_epithelium_united %>% select(name, geometry)
  
  villi_lamina_propria_united <- tissues_villi %>%
    filter(classification == "lamina_propria") %>%
    group_by(image_name, fragment_name, mucosa_name, name, classification, objectType, isLocked) %>%
    summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(classification = paste("villi", classification, sep = "_"))
  
  villi_lamina_propria_geom <- villi_lamina_propria_united %>% select(name, geometry)
  
  villi_lumen_united <- tissues_villi %>%
    filter(classification == "lumen") %>%
    group_by(image_name, fragment_name, mucosa_name, name, classification, objectType, isLocked) %>%
    summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(classification = paste("villi", classification, sep = "_"))
  
  crypts_epithelium_united <- tissues_crypts %>%
    filter(classification == "epithelium") %>%
    group_by(image_name, fragment_name, mucosa_name, name, classification, objectType, isLocked) %>%
    summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(classification = paste("crypts", classification, sep = "_"))
  
  crypts_epithelium_geom <- crypts_epithelium_united %>% select(name, geometry)
  
  crypts_lamina_propria_united <- tissues_crypts %>%
    filter(classification == "lamina_propria") %>%
    group_by(image_name, fragment_name, mucosa_name, name, classification, objectType, isLocked) %>%
    summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(classification = paste("crypts", classification, sep = "_"))
  
  crypts_lamina_propria_geom <- crypts_lamina_propria_united %>% select(name, geometry)
  
  crypts_lumen_united <- tissues_crypts %>%
    filter(classification == "lumen") %>%
    group_by(image_name, fragment_name, mucosa_name, name, classification, objectType, isLocked) %>%
    summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(classification = paste("crypts", classification, sep = "_"))
  
  lymphocytes_path <- paste0(combos_dir, image_fragment, "_lymphocytes.geojson")
  
  lymphocytes <- st_read(lymphocytes_path, quiet = TRUE) %>% 
    st_set_crs(0) %>%
    mutate(area = st_area(geometry)) %>% #this part removes any duplicate lymphocytes (not present in all)
      group_by(name) %>%
      arrange(desc(area)) %>%
      slice(1) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      select(-area) %>%
    select(image_name, fragment_name, name:isLocked, geometry)
  
  lymphocyte_outlines_geom <- lymphocytes %>% select(name, geometry)
  
  image_lymphocytes <- nrow(lymphocytes)
  
  lymphocyte_centroids <- st_centroid(lymphocytes) 
  
  villi_epithelium_lymphocytes <- filter_objects_in_region(lymphocyte_centroids, villi_epithelium_geom) %>%
    mutate(classification = paste("villi_epithelium", classification, sep = "_")) %>%
    select(- tissue_index)
  
  villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_outlines <- villi_epithelium_lymphocytes %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    left_join(lymphocyte_outlines_geom)
  
  villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes <- filter_objects_in_region(lymphocyte_centroids, villi_lamina_propria_geom) %>%
    mutate(classification = paste("villi_lamina_propria", classification, sep = "_")) %>%
    select(- tissue_index)
  
  villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_outlines <- villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    left_join(lymphocyte_outlines_geom)
  
  crypts_epithelium_lymphocytes <- filter_objects_in_region(lymphocyte_centroids, crypts_epithelium_geom) %>%
    mutate(classification = paste("crypts_epithelium", classification, sep = "_")) %>%
    select(- tissue_index)
  
  crypts_epithelium_lymphocytes_outlines <- crypts_epithelium_lymphocytes %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    left_join(lymphocyte_outlines_geom)
  
  crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocytes <- filter_objects_in_region(lymphocyte_centroids, crypts_lamina_propria_geom) %>%
    mutate(classification = paste("crypts_lamina_propria", classification, sep = "_")) %>%
    select(- tissue_index)
  
  crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_outlines <- crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocytes %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    left_join(lymphocyte_outlines_geom)
  
  
  mucosa_lymphocyte_centroids <- bind_rows(villi_epithelium_lymphocytes,
                                           villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes,
                                           crypts_epithelium_lymphocytes,
                                           crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocytes) %>%
    mutate(mucosa_name = mucosa$mucosa_name) %>%
    select(image_name, fragment_name, mucosa_name, name:geometry)
  
  lymphocyte_outlines_united <- bind_rows(villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_outlines,
                                           villi_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_outlines,
                                           crypts_epithelium_lymphocytes_outlines,
                                           crypts_lamina_propria_lymphocytes_outlines) %>%
    group_by(image_name, fragment_name, classification, objectType, isLocked) %>%
    summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(mucosa_name = mucosa$mucosa_name,
           name = classification)
  
  mucosa_select <- mucosa %>% 
    mutate(name = paste("mucosa", orientation_class, artefact_class, "artefact", sep = "_"),
           classification = "mucosa",
           objectType = "annotation",
           isLocked = TRUE) %>%
    select(image_name, fragment_name, mucosa_name, name, classification, objectType, isLocked, geometry)
  
  mucosa_layers_tissues_and_lymphocytes <- bind_rows(mucosa_select,
                                                     villi_united, 
                                                     crypts_united, 
                                                     villi_epithelium_united, 
                                                     villi_lamina_propria_united,
                                                     villi_lumen_united,
                                                     crypts_epithelium_united, 
                                                     crypts_lamina_propria_united,
                                                     crypts_lumen_united,
                                                     lymphocyte_outlines_united) 
  
  st_write(mucosa_layers_tissues_and_lymphocytes, paste0(output_dir, muc, "_mapped_ai_output.geojson"), quiet = TRUE, delete_dsn = TRUE)
  
  st_write(mucosa_lymphocyte_centroids, paste0(output_dir, muc, "_lymphocyte_centroids.geojson"), quiet = TRUE, delete_dsn = TRUE)
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
}
```
